She says that stuff is 'disrespectful' but it's so minor and I don't get why it bothers her so much and why she can't let things go. Shit happens in the real world you just gotta deal with. Yesterday she was making dinner for her, my mom and my dad but I was doing something else. I went to put something in the oven and she said "I needed that for anything." She scoffed and said the same back to me. I told her that her attitude was going to get her in trouble in the real world and she said 'think I'll be just fine, but thanks for the advice.' AITA? I don't know why she hates me so much and is so goddamn controlling.
